blocks.html: Magdalena Firlit is a Professional Scrum Trainer and an experienced Scrum coach, graduated life & business coach (ICF diploma), mentor, Agile coach, graduated trainer, and consultant at magdalenafirlit.com She is a founder and CEO of the company Agile in the Spotlight. Mentoring experience since 2014. As a mentor, and now a mentor for mentors, serves Women in Technology Poland. Also, organizes workshops for new mentors about the process and key points.
